purpose: Teach: しまお/登勢/橘/ウチダ/岡野/石毛/田代/安井

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが漫画家しまおさんと文通された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he used to exchange letters with the manga artist Shimao.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gentle reaching back into memory. Warm but slightly distant, as if seeing it through years. Steady, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、登勢おばあちゃんと俳句を詠まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you used to compose haiku with Tose when you were young, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright, knowing playfulness. A gentle tease wrapped in affection. Warm, conversational rhythm. Eyes crinkling at the corners.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが橘家との家族ぐるみの交流があった
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he had a close family friendship with the Tachibana household.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before continuing. Quieter, more reflective than the first line. Drawing out the memory with care. Tender underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、カメラのウチダ写真機店に通われたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you used to visit Uchida Camera Shop regularly back then, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle knowing laugh in the voice. Teasing but never unkind. A shared secret between old friends. Warm, intimate tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが岡野さんと音楽鑑賞された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he and Okano used to enjoy listening to music together.
lines.style: Softer attack this time. Voice settling into deeper nostalgia. Slower pace. A smile in the memory, but tinged with the weight of years.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、石毛さんと将棋を指されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you used to play shogi with Ishige, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Playful sparkle in the delivery. Light, quick rhythm. Affectionate jab — you're caught in your own memories now. Warm and intimate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが田代まさしの楽曲を口ずさまれた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he would hum songs by Tashiro Masashi.
lines.style: Quietest of all the lines. Almost confiding. Voice trails slightly on the image. Genuinely moved by the smallness of the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、安井氏と海外進出を企画されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you planned to expand overseas with Yasui back then, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, tender close. Affection and pride in the memory. Gentle finality in the delivery. A moment of real seeing between them.
